title: titanic
summary: A personal Titanic-dataset exploration repository that bundles a vendored copy of the 'dsa2' automated feature-engineering framework (including the deltapy sub-project) in its source tree. Within that vendored documentation appears an example snippet using the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer to fit synthetic tabular data, arriving as inherited third-party content rather than something the repository's own Titanic code calls.
needs: No README exists for this repo; title is a guess from the slug. CTGAN usage appears only inside a vendored dsa2/deltapy example doc, not in the repository's own Titanic analysis code, so it's unclear if it was ever executed.
